blacklistabilityReview.evidence: avUSD remains Upstream through measured published external reserve composition, with medium confidence in issuer reporting rather than independent reserve assurance. Avalanche is the material deployment (98.6001% of the 2026-10-19 supply census). At Avalanche block 97945563, hash 0x29e60db7db9bda6ca6b0722c948d3ccc38add149f5ec84df69d30844a5a0cc40 (2026-10-19T06:36:08Z), token 0x24de8771bc5ddb3362db529fc3358f2df3a0e346 is a verified non-proxy AvUSD with zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots and owner 0xd4d23209aae8630bf386b7393763a5b7865e57cb. Ownable2Step minters are mint-only; ERC20Burnable burnFrom spends holder allowance. There is no upgrade dispatch, holder blacklist, seizure, transfer pause or arbitrary-holder burner. AvantMintingV2 0xcb43139e90f019624e3b76c56fb05394b162a49c is an active minter bound to avUSD; redemption settles holder-signed allowance-backed orders without a per-benefactor blacklist/whitelist. Global maxRedeem and disableMintRedeem are protocol-global switches, not named-holder gates. At Monad block 114685655 (2026-10-19T06:37:37Z), supply is 1,682,614.574735634101695581 avUSD, consistent with the sub-threshold 1.3999%; official CCIP pool 0x4235afa8073d6cd8abddd23a080c1ed29978eb76 is the enumerated burner/minter. No parent is declared. The issuer dashboard observed 2026-10-19T06:33:06Z reports the period ending 2026-10-13T23:59:59Z: $971,247,165.116362 gross assets, $849,088,549.928627 financing liabilities and $122,158,630.062517 NAV. Remove $9.300609902021 savUSD self-wrapper value from both numerator and denominator; the external published-asset denominator is $971,247,155.815752. Four qualifying core holdings total $947,303,869.103725, giving a conservative 97.53478952% external exposure, above 50%, with all remaining external assets retained denominator-only. USDe counts categorically because the contemporaneous Ethena disclosure establishes a conservative $2,924,053,250 / $4,687,310,015 = 62.38233103% issuer/custodian-controlled backing floor. Maple syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT are claims on institutional portfolios managed/issued by Maple International Operations SPC, not assumed one-to-one USDC/USDT reserves. Governance-only controls do not count. For v4.4 sensitivity, retaining savUSD gives 97.53478858% on the gross asset denominator, also above 50%. Assigning all financing liabilities against the qualifying holdings leaves an 80.39982040% reported-NAV floor; assets less liabilities differs from NAV by $14.8747814 and that discrepancy is not favorably allocated. A nonbinding pro-rata-USDe sensitivity was 67.65640944% of gross assets. Exact receipt/escrow joins, legal financing priority and independent reserve-to-liability assurance remain unavailable; contract/OPSEC audits are not reserve attestations. These qualifications limit the published-book claim but do not erase its measurable external reserve majority.

oracleRisk.summary: The native Avalanche avUSD contract is an owner-administered ERC-20 with an authorized-minter map, not a collateralized-debt engine: its verified source has no price-feed, borrower collateral-health, or forced-liquidation logic.

branchApplicability.rationale: Avant documents avUSD as an Avalanche-native USDC mint and redemption asset. At Avalanche C-Chain block 90331106, the verified non-proxy avUSD contract exposes ERC-20 operations and owner-managed minter authorization, but no oracle, debt-position, collateral-health, or liquidation function. The PriceStorage documented for the separate avUSDx junior token does not establish a CDP oracle branch for avUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: avUSD is Avalanche-native and has five documented CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1 representations verified at pinned 2026-10-01 blocks. The Avant admin directly holds mint/burn roles on Ethereum and Linea representations; Base, Berachain and Monad currently enumerate only their documented pool. Pool versions do not establish every authorized ramp or verifier configuration, and issuer CCIP/LayerZero wording does not identify an avUSD OFT deployment.
